rows.grounds: object denoting a classification or variety
connective particle adding to prior classifications

items.question: Into how many divisions is the variety of extreme appearance classified?
premises: The passage continues a sequence of classifications.
The division is specified as that of extreme appearance.
The stated number of divisions is ninefold.
items.inference: The variety of extreme appearance is classified into nine divisions.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal referent of atyantābhāsa in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: And, O best of the twice-born, the division of extreme appearance is ninefold.
